CREATE TABLE course_assignments (
	course_version_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	user_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	assigned_by VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	due_date VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL, 
	started_at DATETIME, 
	completed_at DATETIME, 
	best_score FLOAT, 
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (course_version_id, user_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(course_version_id) REFERENCES course_versions (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(assigned_by) REFERENCES users (id)
)

CREATE TABLE lesson_progress (
	assignment_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	lesson_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (assignment_id, lesson_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(assignment_id) REFERENCES course_assignments (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(lesson_id) REFERENCES lessons (id)
)

CREATE TABLE quiz_attempts (
	assignment_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	quiz_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	score FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	passed BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(assignment_id) REFERENCES course_assignments (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(quiz_id) REFERENCES quizzes (id)
)

CREATE TABLE quiz_answers (
	attempt_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	question_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	selected INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	correct BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (attempt_id, question_id), 
	CHECK (selected >= 0 AND selected <= 3), 
	FOREIGN KEY(attempt_id) REFERENCES quiz_attempts (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(question_id) REFERENCES quiz_questions (id)
)

CREATE TABLE training_events (
	title VARCHAR(240) NOT NULL, 
	starts_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	location VARCHAR(240) NOT NULL, 
	department_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	group_id VARCHAR(36), 
	creator_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(department_id) REFERENCES departments (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(group_id) REFERENCES staff_groups (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(creator_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)

CREATE TABLE staff_credentials (
	user_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	title VARCHAR(240) NOT NULL, 
	kind VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, 
	issuer VARCHAR(240) NOT NULL, 
	issue_date VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL, 
	expiry_date VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL, 
	verified BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	reminder_days JSON NOT NULL, 
	file_key VARCHAR(150), 
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)

CREATE TABLE reminders (
	user_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	credential_id VARCHAR(36), 
	assignment_id VARCHAR(36), 
	scheduled_date VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL, 
	message VARCHAR(300) NOT NULL, 
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(credential_id) REFERENCES staff_credentials (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(assignment_id) REFERENCES course_assignments (id)
)
